svg.text: Root sheet: Daisy Seed module, mating headers, muxed panel inputs and pull-ups. All 107 SMT placements are on the bottom side.
Rails: U16 5V -> Seed VIN (pin 39, P5V); Seed V3V3_D (pin 38) -> P3V3_D; Seed V3V3_A (pin 21) -> P3V3_A. No 3.3V regulator on this board.
CN1/CN2 are X4612WV-16I-C40D28-E60 (C2883069): 6mm shoulder and 4mm post across 11mm clear spacers. CN4 is the 8-way strip cut to 7 ways.
CN1 = MIDI in/out, M_ADC_0..7, LED, P3V3_D, P3V3_A, GND. CN2 = jack bus. CN3 = SD card. CN4 = OLED. H1 = PMOD, right angle.
INTERFACE RULE (doc/FRONTBOARD-INTERFACE.md): M_ADC_0..7 may only be driven by dividers powered from this board's P3V3_A and GND, 0..3.3V in every power order.
U1 CD4051 (P3V3_A) multiplexes M_ADC_0..7 onto MULTIPLEX_ADC_1; C31 100nF is its local bypass (7.71mm rail leg).
R51/R52 4.7k pull up I2C SCL/SDA to P3V3_D; R53..R57 47k pull up SD DAT0..3 and CMD.
C1 10uF on P5V, C29 100nF and C30 10uF on P3V3_D. Decoupling pairs move with their IC (AGENTS.md section 3).
MIDI sheet: 31.25kbaud current loop, 3.3V signaling per MIDI CA-033. Logical 0 = current ON = start bit.
MIDI IN: J_MIDI_IN_RING -> J1 shunts -> R47 220R -> U15 LED (pin 1/3) -> J_MIDI_IN_TIP. D1 is the reverse clamp across the LED.
J1 shunts: Type A = 3-5 + 4-6 (ring to anode, tip to cathode); Type B = 4-2 + 3-1. Two 2.54mm shunts, not board parts.
U15 TLP2361 (C107626): IFHL 1.6mA max at 125C, IF recommended 2..6mA, inverting totem-pole output (VO low = LED on). C28 100nF pins 6/4.
R48 2.2k2 is a fail-safe pull-up on USART1_RX (1.5mA when VO is low, inside the 3.2mA VOL rating).
MIDI OUT: ring (DIN 4) is the source through Q2 + R59 33R 1W; tip (DIN 5) is the sink through R60 22R 1W to GND. Never cross tip/ring.
Q2 AO3401A P-FET (C15127): source on P3V3_D, OFF at idle and high-Z (R61 2.2k holds the gate at the source), ON for the start bit.
Gate network: R58 180R from USART1_TX, peak bound 19.44mA, VGS(on) -2.528V worst case, RDS(on) <= 85mR at VGS = -2.5V, 1.5mA DC through R61.
Faults with the driver on: ring to GND = 100mA and 0.33W in R59; tip forced to +3.3V = 0.50W in R60 (no transistor in the tip leg).
Loop current into a 1.9V + 220R receiver: 4.31mA worst case (3.135V, 1% parts, RDS(on) 0.13R), 5.3mA typical. Limits: doc/ELECTRICAL-VERIFICATION.md.
Audio sheet: two TL074 stages, VCC / VEE rails, one 100nF pair per package (C4/C5 at U2, C10/C11 at U3).
Audio in (U2, A-D): 100k input and feedback, 0.1000 V/V simulated, -3 dB at 19.7kHz. R1/R2 100k, C2/C3 47pF, C6/C7 560pF feedback.
Audio out (U3, A-D): gain 3.300 (10.37dB) from the Seed inputs AUDIO_OUT_L/R, -3 dB at 30.9kHz simulated (30.0kHz with the TL074 model).
R11/R12 10k input, R13/R14 33k feedback, R19/R20 1k series at the jack. 1Vrms full scale becomes 4.62V peak, inside the +/-11.7V rails.
Both audio chains have TWO cascaded poles: quote the simulated 19.7kHz / 30.9kHz, not a single-pole estimate.
R9/R10 1k feed the Seed's AUDIO_IN_L/R from U2B/U2D; the Seed input is 3.3V-only, so the in-stage gain stays below 1.
All values in tools/sim/audio_in.cir and audio_out.cir; results in tools/sim/RESULTS.md (simulated, not measured).
CV sheet: CV in (U13), DAC followers (U11A/D), CV out (U12), sync in/out (Q1), -10V reference (U14).
HARD firmware: the STM32H750 DAC buffer must be DISABLED (libDaisy buff_state = DISABLED). U11A/U11D are unity followers on the DAC (pin 30/29).
CV out: U12A/U12C amplify 1.5121x. R45/R46 1k sit INSIDE the loop, so the output is load independent; feedback is taken at the jack (R39/R40 100k).
C33/C34 100pF across R39/R40 are load compensation (15.9kHz zero): the CV out cable/load capacitance limit is 10nF.
Sync: Q1 MMBT3904 inverter from J_SYNC_IN (R22 100k), D5 1N4148 clamps the base-emitter; SYNC_OUT through R29 1k.
Reference: U14 LM4040 -10V on N10V_REF, R41 2.2k from VEE. C20 100nF at U14, C19 100nF at U13, C14/C15 at U11, C17/C18 at U12.
Power sheet: Eurorack entry, +/-12V rails and the 5V converter. P3V3_A and P3V3_D come from the Seed, not from here.
J2 = 2x8 IDC Eurorack header (P12V/N12V/GND). D3/D4 are the reverse-polarity Schottky diodes; C22/C23 10uF and C24/C25 100uF are the rail bulk.
U16 B2405S-2WR3 (C5369484) is the 2W/400mA 5V module, 24V input across VCC-VEE (23.4V typical), C32 1uF at its input pins, L1/L2 ferrites.
Worst-case P5V load: 194mA without the H1 module, 267mA with it = 67% of the rating. Bring-up PASS criterion <= 300mA (doc/POWER-BUDGET.md).
C26 10uF sits across VCC/VEE before the ferrites; C27 10uF is the P5V output capacitor.
Rails are not load-bearing: the bottom GND pour is added after routing, so GND is routed copper plus the plane (AGENTS.md section 8).
